settings.intro: RunecraftHelper: while the in-game Runeshape Combinations panel is open, the poe.ninja Exalted price is drawn on the right edge of each visible reward row. The reward name shown is the game's own (any client language).
status.label: Status: {0}
mono.glow_hint:
Labels a monolith on the large map with a watched rune found on a glowing
socket. Highest-weight match shows; ties show all. Defaults can be toggled off but not removed.
mono.highlight_locked_hint: Gold border on the panel row of a sealed monolith's locked-in recipe.
mono.highlight_threshold_hint:
Tints a monolith's header by its best reward value: green at/above the
threshold, yellow from 0.6× up to it, none below. 0 = off (use Price color).
mono.map_value_hint: Paints each monolith's best value (ex) on the large-map overlay
mono.hide_map_when_panel: Hide map values while Combinations panel open
exp.planner_hint: A planner window appears while the in-game explosive HUD is visible
exp.spine_hint:
Large map (Tab): draws the Router's strict-spine polyline (cyan) — the path
walked (detonator → anchors), shown separately from the charge placements.
exp.log_hint:
Writes a full decision trace on each Run (every candidate, its score,
rejections, gate openings, final pick) to expedition_planner_log.txt in the
plugin folder. For debugging why the route chose a path.
exp.run_tip_stale: Settings changed — click to (re)build the route.
exp.manual_hint: Controller + HUD unreadable — set total to match the in-game counter, then Run.
exp.last_plan: last plan: {0:F0} ms · A* {1} run = {2:F0} ms · {3} cached
exp.map_mods_hint: auto-detected from the map's Expedition modifiers
exp.eff_values: → distance {0:F0} grid · radius {1:F0} grid · {2} base  (auto each map)
exp.monolith_min_hint: Monoliths with best reward ≥ this are routed.
exp.weight_profiles_hint: Weight profiles (create / edit the tables in Settings → Show route planner):
exp.min_markers_hint:
After monoliths, a spare charge is used only if it covers this many
markers at once (normal maps; Grand routes every weighted target).
prof.reward_hint:
Weight each reward marker (0 = ignore, blank types default to 1). Monoliths are
valued by their real reward price — this profile only weights the markers.
prof.buff_hint:
Weight each relic mod (a plain weight, not ex). A relic becomes a route target when its
Σ(+ weights) − Σ(− weights) is > 0; otherwise it's ignored. Both columns take positive
numbers — the − column is an avoidance penalty. Stored by internal mod id (any language).
